# qmllint for the QML lint job in ci.yml, from Qt for Python.
#
# omapad itself installs nothing; this is CI's only download from PyPI. Exact
# versions and hashes, installed with --require-hashes --only-binary :all:, so
# a re-uploaded or look-alike wheel fails the install instead of running.
# 6.11 is the Qt an up-to-date Arch - so Omarchy - ships; Ubuntu's own qmllint
# is 6.4, which cannot read what this QML is written in.
pyside6-essentials==6.11.2 \
    --hash=sha256:aaf9f25f0f324874085fa5b26a610318db8a8e243cf85bb3e5400595191c7778
shiboken6==6.11.2 \
    --hash=sha256:7a7a0a72a9ed26c9bf77d42246b1c736486befb8f31aa2fb29957ea4cdd1c1c2
